s0401.literal: The Chaghan Na'ur Bandit-Capture Office was established, rank 7b.
s0401.idiomatic: The Chaghan Na'ur Bandit-Capture Office was established, rank 7b.

s0402.literal: On gengwu day Zhe-Dong commander-in-chief Zheng You together with Jiang-Zhe military officers was ordered to drill the navy.
s0402.idiomatic: On gengwu day Zhe-Dong commander-in-chief Zheng You together with Jiang-Zhe military officers was ordered to drill the navy.

s0403.literal: On xinwei day ten thousand ingots of notes were granted to repair Xiangshan Yong'an Temple.
s0403.idiomatic: On xinwei day 10,000 ingots of notes were granted to repair Xiangshan Yong'an Temple.

s0404.literal: Prince of Zhao's Ru'an Commandery reported famine; eight hundred shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0404.idiomatic: Prince of Zhao's Ru'an Commandery reported famine; 800 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0405.literal: Baoding Route's qianhu office was promoted to upper qianhu.
s0405.idiomatic: Baoding Route's qianhu office was promoted to upper qianhu.

s0406.literal: On guiyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0406.idiomatic: On guiyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0407.literal: On bingzi day Venus was visible in daylight.
s0407.idiomatic: On bingzi day Venus was visible in daylight.

s0408.literal: Princess of Ju State Manggotai was enfeoffed Grand Princess, and granted a gold seal.
s0408.idiomatic: Princess of Ju State Manggotai was enfeoffed Grand Princess, and granted a gold seal.

s0409.literal: Yehke jarquchi were increased to forty-two posts.
s0409.idiomatic: Yehke jarquchi were increased to 42 posts.

s0410.literal: On renyang day Mars transgressed Ghost.
s0410.idiomatic: On renyang day Mars transgressed Ghost.

s0411.literal: An edict ordered the crown prince Shidebala to establish four night guards.
s0411.idiomatic: An edict ordered the crown prince Shidebala to establish four night guards.

s0412.literal: An edict stated: "For monks' fields, aside from those held since Song times and those granted by Shizu, all the rest shall pay rent according to regulation.
s0412.idiomatic: An edict stated, "For monks' fields, aside from those held since Song times and those granted by Shizu, all the rest shall pay rent according to regulation.

s0413.literal: " Asu Guard commander Nahua and others falsely added six hundred guard soldiers, embezzling seven thousand two hundred shi of grain, one thousand two hundred bolts of silks and cloths, and two hundred eighty ingots of notes; the central secretariat and privy council were ordered to investigate and punish.
s0413.idiomatic: Asu Guard commander Nahua and others falsely added 600 guard soldiers, embezzling 7,200 shi of grain, 1,200 bolts of silks and cloths, and 280 ingots of notes; the central secretariat and privy council were ordered to investigate and punish.

s0414.literal: Privy council administrator Muhua was enfeoffed Prince of Guangping.
s0414.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Muhua was enfeoffed Prince of Guangping.

s0415.literal: On guiwei day Mars transgressed Accumulated Corpse Qi.
s0415.idiomatic: On guiwei day Mars transgressed Accumulated Corpse Qi.

s0416.literal: On gengyin day Venus crossed the meridian.
s0416.idiomatic: On gengyin day Venus crossed the meridian.

s0417.literal: The Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple was completed; the Longxi Court was established.
s0417.idiomatic: The Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple was completed; the Longxi Court was established.

s0418.literal: Longxing's Xinjian County suffered crop damage from prolonged rain; Zhangde's Anyang County suffered locusts.
s0418.idiomatic: Longxing's Xinjian County suffered crop damage from prolonged rain; Zhangde's Anyang County suffered locusts.

s0419.literal: Fifth month, bingchen new moon: central secretariat grand councillor Hesan was made left chancellor of the central secretariat; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Zhang Lü was made central secretariat grand councillor; and privy council administrator Yesian Temür was granted Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial standing as the Three Excellencies.
s0419.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingchen new moon: central secretariat grand councillor Hesan was made left chancellor of the central secretariat; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Zhang Lü was made central secretariat grand councillor; and privy council administrator Yesian Temür was granted Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial standing as the Three Excellencies.

s0420.literal: On renyin day Prince Tuohusi Haimishi hunted during the farming season and disturbed the people; an edict forbade this — from now on hunting was permitted only from the tenth month.
s0420.idiomatic: On renyin day Prince Tuohusi Haimishi hunted during the farming season and disturbed the people; an edict forbade this — from now on hunting was permitted only from the tenth month.

s0421.literal: Karakorum Route was changed to Kening Route.
s0421.idiomatic: Karakorum Route was changed to Kening Route.

s0422.literal: Prince Amuge was granted ten thousand ingots of notes; Susudier and Amasi each one thousand ingots.
s0422.idiomatic: Prince Amuge was granted 10,000 ingots of notes; Susudier and Amasi each 1,000 ingots.

s0423.literal: Mongol relay stations were placed under the Bureau of Transmission; four prince-tutor posts were established for Prince of Puyang Totoqmor; three hundred relay horses at Shangdu and Luanyang were granted.
s0423.idiomatic: Mongol relay stations were placed under the Bureau of Transmission; four prince-tutor posts were established for Prince of Puyang Totoqmor; 300 relay horses at Shangdu and Luanyang were granted.

s0424.literal: On jiwei day a cool hall was built at the Jishan County traveling palace.
s0424.idiomatic: On jiwei day a cool hall was built at the Jishan County traveling palace.

s0425.literal: On jiyou day Xining Prefecture's field rent and commercial taxes were granted to Grand Princess Manggotai; twenty thousand shi of grain were granted to relieve the night guards.
s0425.idiomatic: On jiyou day Xining Prefecture's field rent and commercial taxes were granted to Grand Princess Manggotai; 20,000 shi of grain were granted to relieve the night guards.

s0426.literal: The Huihui Directorate of Astronomy was promoted to rank 4a.
s0426.idiomatic: The Huihui Directorate of Astronomy was promoted to rank 4a.

s0427.literal: Zhangde, Henan, and Longxi suffered hail.
s0427.idiomatic: Zhangde, Henan, and Longxi suffered hail.

s0428.literal: Sixth month, yichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0428.idiomatic: Sixth month, yichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

s0429.literal: On dingmao day heaven rained hair.
s0429.idiomatic: On dingmao day heaven rained hair.

s0430.literal: On jisi day the moon transgressed Heaven's Gate.
s0430.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon transgressed Heaven's Gate.

s0431.literal: An edict ordered Li Meng broadly to select talented scholars from within and without the court for appointment in the Hanlin Academy.
s0431.idiomatic: An edict ordered Li Meng broadly to select talented scholars from within and without the court for appointment in the Hanlin Academy.

s0432.literal: Prices for sheep, horses, and notes were granted to relieve the poor among garrison troops on the northern frontier and in Gansu.
s0432.idiomatic: Prices for sheep, horses, and notes were granted to relieve the poor among garrison troops on the northern frontier and in Gansu.

s0433.literal: On renshen day Sichuan's salt quota was reduced by five thousand yin.
s0433.idiomatic: On renshen day Sichuan's salt quota was reduced by 5,000 yin.

s0434.literal: One hundred qing of Henan official land were granted to Chongfu Temple.
s0434.idiomatic: 100 qing of Henan official land were granted to Chongfu Temple.

s0435.literal: On dinghai day an edict abolished posthumous enfeoffments, admonished those close at hand to observe law and regulation, attend diligently to their duties, and not rashly seek advancement by luck.
s0435.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict abolished posthumous enfeoffments, admonished those close at hand to observe law and regulation, attend diligently to their duties, and not rashly seek advancement by luck.

s0436.literal: Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was granted one hundred taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and one thousand ingots of notes.
s0436.idiomatic: Prince of Anyuan Chouhan was granted 100 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0437.literal: Gongchang, Hezhou, and other routes suffered famine; two-tenths of the regular levy were remitted.
s0437.idiomatic: Gongchang, Hezhou, and other routes suffered famine; two-tenths of the regular levy were remitted.

s0438.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinchou day: the Inner Rectification Bureau was fixed at six posts.
s0438.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinchou day: the Inner Rectification Bureau was fixed at six posts.

s0439.literal: Princes were forbidden to issue edicts directly to the various routes.
s0439.idiomatic: Princes were forbidden to issue edicts directly to the various routes.

s0440.literal: The Central Capital's inner treasury gold and silver vessels were moved to the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
s0440.idiomatic: The Central Capital's inner treasury gold and silver vessels were moved to the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

s0441.literal: Three thousand eight hundred ingots of notes were granted to the relay stations at Xindian for envoys' provisions.
s0441.idiomatic: 3,800 ingots of notes were granted to the relay stations at Xindian for envoys' provisions.

s0442.literal: On guimao day an edict commended the Censorate.
s0442.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict commended the Censorate.

s0443.literal: On bingwu day the Ministry of Revenue was promoted to rank 1b.
s0443.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Ministry of Revenue was promoted to rank 1b.

s0444.literal: The Emperor instructed the Ministry of Revenue: "Agriculture and sericulture are the root of clothing and food; you should appoint those versed in farming affairs.
s0444.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed the Ministry of Revenue, "Agriculture and sericulture are the root of clothing and food; you should appoint those versed in farming affairs.

s0445.literal: " An edict ordered the commoner fields of Prince Xiaoxie's fief returned to the people of Xiangyuan County, Jinning Route.
s0445.idiomatic: An edict ordered the commoner fields of Prince Xiaoxie's fief returned to the people of Xiangyuan County, Jinning Route.

s0446.literal: Central secretariat associate administrator Jia Jun requested leave on grounds of illness; three hundred ingots of notes were granted, and a comfort carriage was given for his return home.
s0446.idiomatic: Central secretariat associate administrator Jia Jun requested leave on grounds of illness; 300 ingots of notes were granted, and a comfort carriage was given for his return home.

s0447.literal: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0447.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0448.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day an edict directed that for Tumet troops' sheep, horses, and cattle the old regulation of one in a hundred was to be levied.
s0448.idiomatic: Eighth month, on dingmao day an edict directed that for Tumet troops' sheep, horses, and cattle the old regulation of one in a hundred was to be levied.

s0449.literal: On wuchen day Venus transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0449.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0450.literal: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Saturn.
s0450.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Saturn.

s0451.literal: On dingchou day the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was abolished.
s0451.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices was abolished.

s0452.literal: On jimao day Minister of Personnel Xu Shijing was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0452.idiomatic: On jimao day Minister of Personnel Xu Shijing was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0453.literal: On gengchen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0453.idiomatic: On gengchen day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0454.literal: On renyang day Mercury transgressed the Right Enforcer.
s0454.idiomatic: On renyang day Mercury transgressed the Right Enforcer.

s0455.literal: The Court of the Imperial Manufactories was established, subordinate to the Dadu Resident Commission.
s0455.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Manufactories was established, subordinate to the Dadu Resident Commission.

s0456.literal: On jiashen day Prince Kuokuochu was granted one gold belt, one hundred fifty taels of silver, and two hundred ingots of notes.
s0456.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince Kuokuochu was granted one gold belt, 150 taels of silver, and 200 ingots of notes.

s0457.literal: On yiyou day Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.
s0457.idiomatic: On yiyou day Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.

s0458.literal: On xinmao day an edict addressed Yunnan Province right vice censor Ahutai and others, directing them to lead Mongol troops with the Prince of Yunnan to campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives.
s0458.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict addressed Yunnan Province right vice censor Ahutai and others, directing them to lead Mongol troops with the Prince of Yunnan to campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives.

s0459.literal: Binzhou suffered drought; the people were famished; twenty thousand shi of grain from the Lijin granary were released and sold at reduced price for relief.
s0459.idiomatic: Binzhou suffered drought; the people were famished; 20,000 shi of grain from the Lijin granary were released and sold at reduced price for relief.

s0460.literal: Jing County of Ningguo Route suffered flooding; grain was granted for two months' relief.
s0460.idiomatic: Jing County of Ningguo Route suffered flooding; grain was granted for two months' relief.

s0461.literal: King Chen Yiji of Annam came to court.
s0461.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam came to court.

s0462.literal: Ninth month, on dingyou day Jiang-Zhe sea transport grain was increased by two hundred thousand shi.
s0462.idiomatic: Ninth month, on dingyou day Jiang-Zhe sea transport grain was increased by 200,000 shi.

s0463.literal: On wuxu day the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives and Greater and Lesser Chelì was halted; imperial letters were sent to win them over.
s0463.idiomatic: On wuxu day the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives and Greater and Lesser Chelì was halted; imperial letters were sent to win them over.

s0464.literal: On xinchou day Minister of Education Tian Zhongliang and others were ordered to proceed to Zhending's Yuhua Palace to sacrifice to Ruizong's imperial portrait.
s0464.idiomatic: On xinchou day Minister of Education Tian Zhongliang and others were ordered to proceed to Zhending's Yuhua Palace to sacrifice to Ruizong's imperial portrait.

s0465.literal: The Eight Hundred Wives and Greater and Lesser Chelì presented tame elephants and local products.
s0465.idiomatic: The Eight Hundred Wives and Greater and Lesser Chelì presented tame elephants and local products.

s0466.literal: On jiachen day deliberator on central secretariat affairs Abuhaiya was promoted to associate administrator.
s0466.idiomatic: On jiachen day deliberator on central secretariat affairs Abuhaiya was promoted to associate administrator.

s0467.literal: The Duke of State and Minister of Education seals worn by Khojas and the like were confiscated.
s0467.idiomatic: The Duke of State and Minister of Education seals worn by Khojas and the like were confiscated.

s0468.literal: On dingsi day the moon transgressed Kang.
s0468.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon transgressed Kang.

s0469.literal: On renxu day Li bandits of Qiongzhou gathered in clamor; officials were dispatched to win them over.
s0469.idiomatic: On renxu day Li bandits of Qiongzhou gathered in clamor; officials were dispatched to win them over.

s0470.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiazi day: rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0470.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jiazi day: rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0471.literal: Longxing Route was changed to Xinghe Route, and granted a silver seal.
s0471.idiomatic: Longxing Route was changed to Xinghe Route, and granted a silver seal.

s0472.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat right vice censor Sanzhierwei was guilty; Imperial Preceptor Dorshiji Ganjjie'er memorialized requesting his release; the Emperor rebuked him, saying: "Monks should recite Buddhist scriptures — how should they meddle in official affairs?
s0472.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat right vice censor Sanzhierwei was guilty; Imperial Preceptor Dorshiji Ganjjie'er memorialized requesting his release; the Emperor rebuked him, saying, "Monks should recite Buddhist scriptures — how should they meddle in official affairs?

s0473.literal: " On guiwei day central secretariat associate administrator Chaghan was made central secretariat grand councillor and deliberator on central secretariat affairs.
s0473.idiomatic: On guiwei day central secretariat associate administrator Chaghan was made central secretariat grand councillor and deliberator on central secretariat affairs.

s0474.literal: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.
s0474.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.

s0475.literal: On wuzi day the moon transgressed Kang.
s0475.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon transgressed Kang.

s0476.literal: Hanlin Academician Exemplar Yulianchibuhua and others presented the Veritable Records of Shunzong, Chengzong, and Wuzong.
s0476.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Exemplar Yulianchibuhua and others presented the Veritable Records of Shunzong, Chengzong, and Wuzong.

s0477.literal: The Shipbuilding Intendant Office was abolished.
s0477.idiomatic: The Shipbuilding Intendant Office was abolished.

s0478.literal: On xinmao day a general amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
s0478.idiomatic: On xinmao day a general amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

s0479.literal: Li Meng was granted twenty qing of fields in Lu Prefecture.
s0479.idiomatic: Li Meng was granted 20 qing of fields in Lu Prefecture.

s0480.literal: Eleventh month, on wuxu day Ting and Zhang She troops were transferred to replace Bozhou and other wing Han troops in local garrison farming.
s0480.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on wuxu day Ting and Zhang She troops were transferred to replace Bozhou and other wing Han troops in local garrison farming.

s0481.literal: On jihai day the moon transgressed Rampart Wall Formation.
s0481.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon transgressed Rampart Wall Formation.

s0482.literal: On jiachen day the bandit gang of Cangzhou, Ashidari and others, was captured; they were dismembered as a public warning.
s0482.idiomatic: On jiachen day the bandit gang of Cangzhou, Ashidari and others, was captured; they were dismembered as a public warning.

s0483.literal: On bingwu day the six ministries were admonished not to bypass the central secretariat in memorializing affairs.
s0483.idiomatic: On bingwu day the six ministries were admonished not to bypass the central secretariat in memorializing affairs.

s0484.literal: On bingchen day imperial son-in-law Totoqmor was enfeoffed Prince of Qi.
s0484.idiomatic: On bingchen day imperial son-in-law Totoqmor was enfeoffed Prince of Qi.

s0485.literal: On gengshen day Princes Kuanche and Hudashimi were granted one hundred fifty taels of gold, one thousand five hundred taels of silver, three thousand ingots of notes, and varying amounts of silks and cloths.
s0485.idiomatic: On gengshen day Princes Kuanche and Hudashimi were granted 150 taels of gold, 1,500 taels of silver, 3,000 ingots of notes, and varying amounts of silks and cloths.

s0486.literal: Champa presented rhinoceros horns and elephants; the king of Burma sent his son-in-law and the chief of Yunnan's Bunong, Cen Fu, to court.
s0486.idiomatic: Champa presented rhinoceros horns and elephants; the king of Burma sent his son-in-law and the chief of Yunnan's Bunong, Cen Fu, to court.

s0487.literal: Twelfth month, on guihai day central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng retired from office; privy council vice director Zhang Gui was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0487.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on guihai day central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng retired from office; privy council vice director Zhang Gui was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0488.literal: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched by separate routes to decide criminal cases.
s0488.idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched by separate routes to decide criminal cases.

s0489.literal: On renshen day the fief of Prince of Jin Yesun Temür reported famine; fifteen thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0489.idiomatic: On renshen day the fief of Prince of Jin Yesun Temür reported famine; 15,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0490.literal: On gengchen day privy council administrator Dashman was dismissed.
s0490.idiomatic: On gengchen day privy council administrator Dashman was dismissed.

s0491.literal: One post of sea-route grain transport qianhu was reduced; vice qianhu were increased to four posts.
s0491.idiomatic: One post of sea-route grain transport qianhu was reduced; vice qianhu were increased to four posts.

s0492.literal: On jiashen day Mars, Saturn, and Mercury gathered at Dipper.
s0492.idiomatic: On jiashen day Mars, Saturn, and Mercury gathered at Dipper.

s0493.literal: Buhuajilie of the Hawk Office requested to go to Henan and Huguang to collect peacocks and rare birds; an edict refused on grounds of disturbing the people.
s0493.idiomatic: Buhuajilie of the Hawk Office requested to go to Henan and Huguang to collect peacocks and rare birds; an edict refused on grounds of disturbing the people.

s0494.literal: On dinghai day officials were dispatched to pray for snow at the altars of soil and grain, mountains and rivers, and seas and streams.
s0494.idiomatic: On dinghai day officials were dispatched to pray for snow at the altars of soil and grain, mountains and rivers, and seas and streams.

s0495.literal: Branch secretariat officials said: "The central secretariat's duty is to hold overall command of the governing framework; recently, when branch secretariats, the six ministries, and various offices should decide but do not, they often submit doubtful consultation memorials, causing documents to proliferate and affairs to grow cumbersome.
s0495.idiomatic: Branch secretariat officials said, "The central secretariat's duty is to hold overall command of the governing framework; recently, when branch secretariats, the six ministries, and various offices should decide but do not, they often submit doubtful consultation memorials, causing documents to proliferate and affairs to grow cumbersome.

s0496.literal: " An edict directed adherence to Shizu's original intent in establishing the central secretariat; procedures were to be fixed and submitted, to be followed in practice.
s0496.idiomatic: An edict directed adherence to Shizu's original intent in establishing the central secretariat; procedures were to be fixed and submitted, to be followed in practice.

s0497.literal: Huihui imam Hede was ordered as before to pray for blessings; all litigation was to revert to the regular offices; previously issued imperial letters were still to be recovered.
s0497.idiomatic: Huihui imam Hede was ordered as before to pray for blessings; all litigation was to revert to the regular offices; previously issued imperial letters were still to be recovered.

s0498.literal: On wuzi day the moon transgressed Mars.
s0498.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon transgressed Mars.

s0499.literal: On jichou day Princess Bandan was given relay vouchers to collect Jiangnan field rent; an order directed the relay vouchers confiscated.
s0499.idiomatic: On jichou day Princess Bandan was given relay vouchers to collect Jiangnan field rent; an order directed the relay vouchers confiscated.
